deft-deceiver: Spend a Hope to gain advantage on a roll to deceive or trick someone into believing a lie you tell.
enrapture: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily Enraptured: their attention is fixed on you, narrowing their view and drowning out all sound but your voice. Once per rest on a success, mark a Stress to force the Enraptured target to mark a Stress too.
inspirational-words:
After a long rest, place {{presence|# tokens|tokens equal to your Presence}} on this card. When you speak with an ally, spend a token to give them one benefit:
- Your ally clears a Stress.
- Your ally clears a Hit Point.
- Your ally gains a Hope.
When you take a long rest, clear unspent tokens.
tell-no-lies: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, they can’t lie to you while within Close range, but aren’t compelled to speak. If you ask a question and they refuse to answer, they mark a Stress and the effect ends. The target is typically unaware of the spell until it makes them utter the truth.
troublemaker: When you taunt or provoke a target within Far range, make a Presence Roll against them. Once per rest on a success, roll {{proficiency|#d4|a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency}}; the target marks Stress equal to the highest result.
hypnotic-shimmer: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Once per rest on a success, create an illusion of flashing colors and lights that temporarily Stuns targets you succeed against and makes them mark a Stress. While Stunned, they can’t use reactions or take other actions until they clear the condition.
invisibility:
Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, mark a Stress and choose yourself or an ally within Melee range to become Invisible: they can’t be seen except through magic, and attack rolls against them have disadvantage. Place {{spellcast|# tokens|tokens equal to your Spellcast trait}} on this card; spend one when the Invisible creature takes an action. After the action that spends the last token, the effect ends.
You can hold Invisibility on only one creature at a time.
soothing-speech: During a short rest, when you comfort another character while using Tend to Wounds on them, clear an additional Hit Point on them. You also clear 2 Hit Points.
through-your-eyes: Choose a target within Very Far range. You can see and hear through them, switching freely between your senses and theirs until you cast another spell or your next rest.
thought-delver:
Spend a Hope to read the vague surface thoughts of a target within Far range. Make a Spellcast Roll against the target to delve for deeper thoughts.
On a roll with Fear, the target might, at the GM’s discretion, become aware you’re reading their thoughts.
words-of-discord:
Whisper words of discord to an adversary within Melee range and make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, the target marks a Stress and attacks another adversary instead of you or your allies.
Afterward, the target realizes what happened; the next time you cast Words of Discord on them, gain a −5 penalty to the Spellcast Roll.
never-upstaged: When you mark 1 or more Hit Points from an attack, mark a Stress to place tokens on this card equal to the Hit Points you marked. On your next successful attack, gain a +5 bonus to your damage roll for each token on this card, then clear all tokens.
share-the-burden: Once per rest, take on Stress from a willing creature within Melee range. They describe what intimate knowledge or emotions telepathically leak from their mind. Transfer any number of their marked Stress to you, then gain a Hope for each Stress transferred.
endless-charisma: After an action roll to persuade, lie, or garner favor, spend a Hope to reroll the Hope or Fear Die.
grace-touched:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Grace domain, gain:
- You can mark an Armor Slot instead of marking a Stress.
- When you would force a target to mark Hit Points, you can instead force them to mark that number of Stress.
astral-projection: Once per long rest, mark a Stress to create a projected copy of yourself that can appear anywhere you’ve been before. You see and hear through it and affect the world as though you were there. A creature investigating it can tell it’s magical. This lasts until your next rest or the projection takes any damage.
mass-enrapture: Make a Spellcast Roll against all targets within Far range. Targets you succeed against become temporarily Enraptured: their attention is fixed on you, narrowing their view and drowning out all sound but your voice. Mark a Stress to force all Enraptured targets to mark a Stress, ending this spell.
copycat: Once per long rest, this card can mimic the features of another domain card of level 8 or lower in another player’s loadout. Spend Hope equal to half its level to gain the feature, until your next rest or they vault the card.
master-of-the-craft: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to two of your Experiences or a permanent +3 bonus to one. Then place this card in your vault permanently.
encore: When an ally within Close range deals damage to an adversary, make a Spellcast Roll against the same target. On a success, deal the same damage to it. If the roll succeeds with Fear, place this card in your vault.
notorious: People know who you are and what you’ve done. When you leverage your notoriety to get what you want, mark a Stress before you roll to gain a +10 bonus to the result. Your food and drinks are always free, and everything else you buy is reduced in price by one bag of gold (to a minimum of one handful).
